questions.stem: 許多嘗試數位排毒（digital detox）的人，開始懷念那段不會時時被手機訊息打擾的日子。
questions.answer: Many people who try a digital detox begin to miss the days when they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages.
accepted_answers: Many of those who go on a digital detox start to miss the time when they were not always interrupted by messages on their phones.
Many people who try a digital detox begin to miss the days when they were not disturbed by phone messages all the time.

patterns: 關係副詞 when（不會時時被打擾的日子＝the days when …）
被動語態（被手機訊息打擾）

questions.stem: 許多人在暫時放下手機後，晚上睡得更好，這也讓他們白天更有精神。
questions.answer: Many people sleep better at night after putting their phones aside temporarily, which also makes them more energetic during the day.
accepted_answers: After putting their phones aside for a while, many people sleep better at night, which also gives them more energy during the day.
Many people sleep better at night after putting down their phones for a while, which also leaves them more energetic during the day.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整句：這也讓他們…）
連接詞＋分詞（after + V-ing：在暫時放下手機後）

1.explanation_zh: 「許多嘗試數位排毒的人」用關係子句 Many people who try a digital detox。「懷念」是 miss。「那段不會時時被手機訊息打擾的日子」中文把子句放在「日子」前，英文用 the days when + 子句；when 在子句裡表時間，所以不用 which。「被…打擾」是被動，寫 they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages（「時時」是 constantly／all the time）。
evidence: 許多嘗試數位排毒（digital detox）的人
那段不會時時被手機訊息打擾的日子
1.strategy_zh: 先寫主幹 Many people … begin to miss the days；再用 when 把「不會時時被手機訊息打擾」接在 the days 後面。
hints: 切成四段：許多嘗試數位排毒的人／開始懷念／不會時時被手機訊息打擾／的日子
標的詞彙：try（嘗試）、miss（懷念）、disturb（打擾）、message（訊息）
句型框架：Many people who + V … + begin to miss + the days when + S + were not constantly + p.p. + by …

2.explanation_zh: 「在暫時放下手機後」和「睡得更好」的主詞都是「許多人」，可以用連接詞＋分詞 after putting their phones aside temporarily（after 後接動名詞；「暫時」可寫 temporarily 或 for a while）。「這也讓他們…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which also makes them more energetic；逗號後不能用 that，也不能直接寫 , this …。「有精神」是 energetic／have more energy，不是 spirit；「白天」是 during the day。
evidence: 這也讓他們白天更有精神
2.strategy_zh: 主要子句 Many people sleep better at night 先寫好，時間用 after + V-ing 補上，最後以 , which … 帶出結果。
hints: 切成四段：在暫時放下手機後／晚上睡得更好／這也讓他們／白天更有精神
標的詞彙：temporarily（暫時地）、phone（手機）、sleep（睡覺）、energetic（有精神的）
句型框架：S + V … after + V-ing …, which also makes + O + adj. …

references: Many people who try a digital detox begin to miss the days when they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages.
Many of those who go on a digital detox start to miss the time when they were not always interrupted by messages on their phones.
Many people who try a digital detox begin to miss the days when they were not disturbed by phone messages all the time.

patterns.label_zh: 關係副詞 when（不會時時被打擾的日子＝the days when …）
patterns.frame: the days/the time + when + S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 那段不會時時被手機訊息打擾的日子

patterns.label_zh: 被動語態（被手機訊息打擾）

parts.zh: 許多嘗試數位排毒（digital detox）的人
accepted: Many people who try a digital detox
Many of those who go on a digital detox
Many people trying a digital detox
Many people who have tried a digital detox
Many people who go on a digital detox

common_errors.right: Many people who try a digital detox
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文的修飾語「嘗試數位排毒的」放在「人」前面；英文要用關係子句 people who … 放在後面。

common_errors.wrong: Many people who tries a digital detox
common_errors.right: Many people who try a digital detox
common_errors.explanation_zh: 先行詞 people 是複數，關係子句的動詞用 try。
「懷念」是想念過去的時光，用 miss；remember 只是「記得」。
主詞 many people 是複數，動詞不加 s。

parts.zh: 不會時時被手機訊息打擾
accepted: they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages
they were not always interrupted by messages on their phones
they were not disturbed by phone messages all the time
they were not constantly bothered by phone messages
they were not constantly interrupted by phone messages

common_errors.wrong: they were not constantly disturbing by phone messages
common_errors.right: they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「被打擾」是被動，要用過去分詞 disturbed；disturbing 是「令人困擾的」。

common_errors.wrong: they were not constantly disturb by phone messages
common_errors.right: they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages
common_errors.explanation_zh: 被動語態 be 後面要接過去分詞 disturbed。

common_errors.wrong: the days which they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages
common_errors.right: the days when they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages
common_errors.explanation_zh: 先行詞 the days 在子句裡表時間，要用關係副詞 when（或 in which）。
「那段日子」指一段時期，用複數 the days 或 the time。

traps.literal_error: begin to miss the days when they were not constantly disturbing by phone messages
traps.explanation_zh: 「被打擾」是被動，要用過去分詞 disturbed；寫成 disturbing 變成「令人困擾的」，意思和語態都錯。

traps.zh: 那段不會時時被手機訊息打擾的日子
traps.literal_error: begin to miss those not constantly disturbed by phone messages days
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把整個子句放在「日子」前面；英文要寫成 the days when + 子句，把子句移到名詞後面。

1.restructuring_zh: 「那段不會時時被手機訊息打擾的日子」中文是前置修飾，英文要把子句移到名詞後面，用關係副詞 when：the days when they were not constantly disturbed by phone messages。

references: Many people sleep better at night after putting their phones aside temporarily, which also makes them more energetic during the day.
After putting their phones aside for a while, many people sleep better at night, which also gives them more energy during the day.
Many people sleep better at night after putting down their phones for a while, which also leaves them more energetic during the day.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整句：這也讓他們…）
連接詞＋分詞（after + V-ing：在暫時放下手機後）
patterns.frame: S + V … after + V-ing … / After + V-ing …, S + V …

accepted: after putting their phones aside temporarily
After putting their phones aside for a while
after putting down their phones for a while
after temporarily putting their phones down
after putting their phones away for a while
after taking a break from their phones

common_errors.wrong: after put their phones aside temporarily
common_errors.right: after putting their phones aside temporarily
common_errors.explanation_zh: after 當介系詞，後面接動名詞 putting（或接完整子句 after they put …）。

common_errors.wrong: after putting their phones aside temporary
common_errors.right: after putting their phones aside temporarily
common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞要用副詞 temporarily。
better 已經是比較級，不加 more。
逗號不能直接連接兩個子句；用 which 指前面整句（或改成句號 This also …）。
非限定關係子句（逗號後）不能用 that。

accepted: feel more energetic during the day

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「有精神」是精力充沛，用 energetic 或 have more energy；spirit 是「心靈、精神面」。

traps.literal_error: which also makes them have more spirit during the day
traps.explanation_zh: 「有精神」不是 spirit（心靈、精神面），而是精力充沛：more energetic 或 more energy。

traps.literal_error: Many people sleep better at night after put their phones aside temporary.
traps.explanation_zh: after 當介系詞時後面接動名詞 putting；修飾動詞的「暫時」要用副詞 temporarily。

bonus.text: The longer people stay away from their phones, the better they sleep, which in turn leaves them full of energy during the day.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 The + 比較級 …, the + 比較級 … 強調遠離手機愈久效果愈好，再用 in turn（進而）點出連鎖結果。

2.restructuring_zh: 「這也讓他們…」的「這」指前面整件事，英文不另起一個用逗號連接的子句，改用非限定關係子句 , which also makes them …。

1.translation: Many people who try a digital detox begin to miss the days when they were not constantly disturbed by messages on their phones.
1.explanation_zh: 「嘗試數位排毒的人」用 who 關係子句；「那段…的日子」用 the days when…；「不會時時被手機訊息打擾」用被動 were not constantly disturbed by；通則敘述用現在簡單式 try／begin。「日子」可能指智慧手機普及前或排毒期間，英文 the days when… 兩種都涵蓋。

2.translation: After putting their phones away for a while, many people sleep better at night, which also makes them more energetic during the day.
2.explanation_zh: 「在…後」用 After＋V-ing；「睡得更好」用比較級 better；「這也讓他們…」指前面整件事，用逗號＋which 非限定關係子句；「更有精神」用 more energetic。

1.translation: Many people who try a digital detox begin to miss the days when they were not constantly interrupted by messages on their phones.
1.explanation_zh: 「嘗試數位排毒的人」用 who 關係子句；「開始懷念」譯為 begin to miss；「那段不會時時被…打擾的日子」用 the days when 關係副詞子句加被動語態 were not constantly interrupted。

2.translation: After putting down their phones for a while, many people sleep better at night, which also makes them more energetic during the day.
2.explanation_zh: 「在暫時放下手機後」用 after + 動名詞，主詞一致（many people）；「這也讓他們白天更有精神」的『這』指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which also makes them more energetic。
